To

       National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Tower 
 
 
       Exchange Plaza, 
Dalal Street,  
 
 
 
       Bandra Kurla Complex, 
Mumbai – 400 001 
 
 
 
       Bandra (E), Mumbai – 400 051 
 
BSE Scrip Code: 500368 
 
 
       NSE Symbol: PATANJALI 
 
Dear Sir(s)/Ma’am, 
 
Sub.: Audio recording of the Earning Conference Call held with investors on August 17, 2026. 
 
Further to our letter dated August 12, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 (2)(oa) of the 
Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015 (“Listing Regulations”), as amended, we may inform you that the recording of 
audio conference call held today i.e. August 17, 2026 with the Analysts/Investors is available on 
the Company’s website i.e. www.patanjalifoods.com 
 
The link to access the said audio recording is: https://www.patanjalifoods.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/Patanjali-Foods-Limited-Q1FY27-Earnings-Call-Audio.mp3.  
 
It is for your information and records please. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours Faithfully, 
 
For Patanjali Foods Limited 
 
 
 
 
Ramji Lal Gupta 
Company Secretary
